ctx: TITLE 12. RIGHTS AND DUTIES OF CONSUMERS AND MERCHANTS

items.t: INAPPLICABILITY OF CHAPTER TO SUBSTITUTED GOODS
l: This chapter does not apply to goods substituted for goods ordered or solicited by the recipient of the goods.

items.t: ACTIONS AUTHORIZED ON DELIVERY OF UNSOLICITED GOODS
l: Unless otherwise agreed, a person to whom unsolicited goods are delivered:
(1) is entitled to refuse to accept delivery of the goods; and
(2) is not required to return the goods to the sender.
(a) Unsolicited goods that are addressed to or intended for the recipient are considered a gift to the recipient.
(b) The recipient may use or dispose of goods described by Subsection (a) in any manner without obligation to the sender.
MISTAKEN DELIVERY. A person who receives unsolicited goods as the result of a bona fide mistake shall return the goods. The sender has the burden of proof as to the mistake.
